proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. The surface union is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — magic items cannot be represented at all.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement by a Spellcaster)

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.dawn
proposed_widenings.justification: Pearl of Power resets at next dawn, not at a short or long rest. No existing RestResetCadence variant covers a daily dawn reset.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemActivationCost.magic_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is activated by taking the Magic action, which is a StandardActionKind but is not covered by ClassFeatureActivationCost (free | bonus_action).
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to regain one expended spell slot

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemEffect.refund_spell_slot
proposed_widenings.justification: The core effect is recovering an expended spell slot. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant (grant_extra_action | heal_hp) can represent this. v4 has a 'refund' procedure atom but the surface has no corresponding effect shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower

proposed_widenings.name: AttunementRequirement
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items can require attunement, with optional constraints on who can attune (e.g., 'by a Spellcaster'). No attunement field exists anywhere in the current surface types. v4 has attunement_slot as a resource atom but the surface has no authored form for it.

notes: The primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not a UnitRecord kind. Even if it were added, four additional surface shapes are required: a dawn reset cadence, a magic-action activation cost, a refund_spell_slot effect, and an attunement requirement field. The v4 taxonomy already has 'refund' (procedure) and 'attunement_slot' (resource) atoms that the new surface shapes would trace to — so this is surface_widening on top of structural_widening, not atom_widening.
